Application Data.NAME: ABC Building Supplies, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ABC Building Supplies, Inc. is a retail business specializing in the supply of high-quality building materials sourced exclusively from approved domestic manufacturers. We provide a comprehensive range of products including lumber, drywall, insulation, plumbing supplies, and electrical components. Our operations emphasize strict inventory management controls, secure indoor storage facilities, and robust fire prevention measures, including fully operational sprinkler systems. We prioritize the safety of our employees and customers by maintaining a well-documented safety program that is rigorously enforced. Our business serves local contractors and homeowners, focusing on renovation and repair projects rather than new construction, thereby minimizing our exposure to higher risk activities. Regular inventory audits and surveillance measures are in place to mitigate risks related to theft and vandalism.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 10, 2023, a minor fire incident occurred in our storage area due to an electrical malfunction. The fire was quickly contained with the assistance of our operational sprinkler system. The estimated damage amount was approximately $5,000, which covered the cost of damaged inventory and repairs to the affected area. The incident was resolved without any injuries, and we have conducted a full safety review to ensure similar incidents do not occur in the future. The claim for the damage has been settled.
